page.layout: One printed page, with a sliver of the facing page at the far left edge (not transcribed). Running head at top; full-width text in one column; no marginal notes on this page; signature at the foot.

main_text.p: de ratione falutis, de poenis impiorum,de præ-miis fidelium,de morte,resurrectione, & ascen-sione Christi,de ministerio verbi instituto, &c.
Lucæ proprium studium erat vt historiam exactam & plenam ex rerum ordine & serie contexeret .Luc. 1. v. 2.3.4. Hinc omnia à primordiis in ipso altè re petita.
main_text.head: DE PRÆFATIONE.
main_text.p: S. Lucas inter cætera & hoc à reliquis Euangelistis peculiare habet,quod reliqui sine Proœ-mio,Lucas autem προοιμιάζων[?] historiam auspicatur. Docemur hinc, non positum in istis pietatis cardinem,sed liberum esse præfari, aut non præfari, modo in capitibus ipsius causæ consensus reperiatur.Scopus & propositio præfationis est:Theophilo (sunt autem omnes verè Christiani theophili)de veritate huius historiæ nullatenus esse dubitandum :1. quia scribat narrationem earum rerum quarum plena fides nobis facta est: 2. idque ab iis qui fuerunt oculati testes & ministri : 3. quia Lucas scribit postquam omnia à principio accuratè persecutus est: quæ omnia ad Theophili diriguntur ædificationem : nam quæ hactenus viva voce didicit,iam scripto quoque leget magis expolita & explicata.

page.notes: The left edge shows part of the facing page (its margin notes); it is not part of this page and was left out. The Greek word προοιμιάζων is uncertain in its accents and letters. The line "sine Proœ-mio" is set tight in print. "Euan" is followed by a small superscript mark, probably a reference, which was not clearly legible and is not transcribed.
